meta.title: Presence Hospitality: Remote front office & holographic reception for hotels
meta.description: Presence Hospitality runs your hotel reception from a central 24/7 hub. Self check-in plus live receptionists who appear as life-size holograms. Night, day or 24/7 packages.

hero.lead: Presence Hospitality runs your reception from one central hub. Guests check in on their own, and when they need someone, a trained receptionist appears in your lobby as a life-size hologram. Day, night, or both.
hero.note: Built for independent hotels and hostels · Live in the Netherlands
hero.portalAlt: Illustration: a receptionist appearing as a hologram inside the Holobox.
hero.title: Stop hiring front desk staff.
